g.text: Passes power and messages between neighbouring backbones.

g.desc: Passes power and messages between neighbouring backbones.

g.text: Six configurable ports. Header and serial LED order: P1-P6.

g.desc: Six configurable ports. Header and serial LED order: P1-P6.

g.text: Provides fixed ESP32, supply and ground connections.

g.desc: Provides fixed ESP32, supply and ground connections.

g.text: U31: LOW selects ESP32, HIGH selects Expansion. Both USB series-resistor pairs are fitted. Owner changes require USB detach and re-enumeration.

g.desc: U31: LOW selects ESP32, HIGH selects Expansion. Both USB series-resistor pairs are fitted. Owner changes require USB detach and re-enumeration.

g.text: Added gate / ISO signals are shared with U25: release its outputs before external drive. VBUS

g.desc: Added gate / ISO signals are shared with U25: release its outputs before external drive. VBUS

g.text: J10 / J11 | EXPANSION INTERFACE - 2 x 60 CONTACTS

g.desc: J10 / J11 | EXPANSION INTERFACE - 2 x 60 CONTACTS

g.text: Q9/Q10 detect both neighbours by TERM current. Q2/U8 insert 120R at either end. No MCU.

g.desc: Q9/Q10 detect both neighbours by TERM current. Q2/U8 insert 120R at either end. No MCU.

g.text: GPIO35/36/37 AUX links are DNP PSRAM guards. Fit only on compatible ESP32 variants. USB does not pass through FPGA logic.

g.desc: GPIO35/36/37 AUX links are DNP PSRAM guards. Fit only on compatible ESP32 variants. USB does not pass through FPGA logic.

g.text: Bottom insertion | 20.72 x 5 x 5 mm | land pattern requires physical qualification

g.desc: Bottom insertion | 20.72 x 5 x 5 mm | land pattern requires physical qualification

g.text: Connects compatible sensors through a four-wire cable.

g.desc: Connects compatible sensors through a four-wire cable.

g.text: Turns controller messages into CAN bus signals.

g.desc: Turns controller messages into CAN bus signals.

g.text: Physical IC groups | all units of each IC together | named nets preserve functional links

g.desc: Physical IC groups | all units of each IC together | named nets preserve functional links

g.text: All six units belong to this single connector.

g.desc: All six units belong to this single connector.

g.text: READING GUIDE: Q3-Q8 = power stages | U12/U13 = signal isolation | J1/J140 = shared headers | R56-R61 = shunts

g.desc: READING GUIDE: Q3-Q8 = power stages | U12/U13 = signal isolation | J1/J140 = shared headers | R56-R61 = shunts

g.text: Adds Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and familiar ESP32 development tools.

g.desc: Adds Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and familiar ESP32 development tools.

g.text: Nessun micro necessario. TERM DX di una scheda si collega a TERM SX della successiva. Corrente di link circa 0.18mA a 5V.

g.desc: Nessun micro necessario. TERM DX di una scheda si collega a TERM SX della successiva. Corrente di link circa 0.18mA a 5V.

g.text: C139/C140 filtrano le basi. R e C: 0603. Tutte le schede devono usare questa revisione; non pilotare TERM dalla mezzanina.

g.desc: C139/C140 filtrano le basi. R e C: 0603. Tutte le schede devono usare questa revisione; non pilotare TERM dalla mezzanina.

g.text: J17 / J20: direct ESP sensor rows, A0-A5 plus mixed 3V3 / GND. J18 / J19: configurable P1-P6.

g.desc: J17 / J20: direct ESP sensor rows, A0-A5 plus mixed 3V3 / GND. J18 / J19: configurable P1-P6.

g.text: BKL 2x8 DUAL ENTRY | SENSOR & CONFIGURABLE HEADERS

g.desc: BKL 2x8 DUAL ENTRY | SENSOR & CONFIGURABLE HEADERS

g.text: P1-P6 = external experiment rows | A0-A5 = ESP-side signals | J3 = separate direct access. Named arrows connect blocks.

g.desc: P1-P6 = external experiment rows | A0-A5 = ESP-side signals | J3 = separate direct access. Named arrows connect blocks.

g.text: Unconnected mechanical samples. Not fitted in production.

g.desc: Unconnected mechanical samples. Not fitted in production.

g.text: 2 x 6 contacts | 2.54 mm pitch | body 15.74 x 5.00 x 8.50 mm

g.desc: 2 x 6 contacts | 2.54 mm pitch | body 15.74 x 5.00 x 8.50 mm

g.text: CJT CONNECTOR FIT TEST | J15 / J16

g.desc: CJT CONNECTOR FIT TEST | J15 / J16

g.text: MEZZ_OWNER LOW = ESP32, HIGH = Expansion. R103 = 100k pull-down; Expansion adds R109 = 10k pull-up. Claim is not firmware-ready. USB, CAN TX, RGB and ISO4/5 are selected.

g.desc: MEZZ_OWNER LOW = ESP32, HIGH = Expansion. R103 = 100k pull-down; Expansion adds R109 = 10k pull-up. Claim is not firmware-ready. USB, CAN TX, RGB and ISO4/5 are selected.

g.text: Simulazione con modelli generici: non qualifica hardware. Verificare contatti, avvio, ESD e CAN sul prototipo.

g.desc: Simulazione con modelli generici: non qualifica hardware. Verificare contatti, avvio, ESD e CAN sul prototipo.

g.text: Q10B: basta un vicino assente per inserire 120R

g.desc: Q10B: basta un vicino assente per inserire 120R

g.text: Rows switch 3V3 / GND / Hi-Z. Never enable both MOSFETs together; set ESP GPIO Hi-Z before switching.

g.desc: Rows switch 3V3 / GND / Hi-Z. Never enable both MOSFETs together; set ESP GPIO Hi-Z before switching.

g.text: TERM AUTOMATICO A CORRENTE | Q9: rilevatori NPN+PNP | Q10: logica NPN+NPN | D7: due diodi OR

g.desc: TERM AUTOMATICO A CORRENTE | Q9: rilevatori NPN+PNP | Q10: logica NPN+NPN | D7: due diodi OR

g.text: Units C/D unused: OE high, input grounded.

g.desc: Units C/D unused: OE high, input grounded.

g.text: is USB voltage, not 3.3 V logic.

g.desc: is USB voltage, not 3.3 V logic.

g.text: A4-A5 / rows P5-P6 | one physical TSSOP-14

g.desc: A4-A5 / rows P5-P6 | one physical TSSOP-14

g.text: All five units + C89 local bypass + ISO pull-ups.

g.desc: All five units + C89 local bypass + ISO pull-ups.

g.text: Powers the carrier and the removable Expansion module.

g.desc: Powers the carrier and the removable Expansion module.

g.text: A0-A3 / rows P1-P4 | one physical TSSOP-14

g.desc: A0-A3 / rows P1-P4 | one physical TSSOP-14

g.text: INTERFACE V3: 120/120 assigned | 17 GND | 6 x 5V | 6 x VCORE | 12 dedicated shunt sense | all services retained.

g.desc: INTERFACE V3: 120/120 assigned | 17 GND | 6 x 5V | 6 x VCORE | 12 dedicated shunt sense | all services retained.

g.text: U25 + C129: common to all variants.

g.desc: U25 + C129: common to all variants.

g.text: One active I2C master at a time.

g.desc: One active I2C master at a time.

g.text: All six units belong to this single connector.

g.desc: All six units belong to this single connector.

g.text: Shared I2C control of the six power stages.

g.desc: Shared I2C control of the six power stages.

g.text: Gives Expansion priority; the base uses ESP32 when no module is fitted.

g.desc: Gives Expansion priority; the base uses ESP32 when no module is fitted.

g.text: Connects USB to the selected controller.

g.desc: Connects USB to the selected controller.

g.text: All five units + C88 local bypass + ISO pull-ups.

g.desc: All five units + C88 local bypass + ISO pull-ups.
